name: @ciri/codec
description: TypeScript decoder for the ciritty wire protocol — frame, state-machine cells, msgpack, LZ4
comment_distribution: ESM consumers must bundle `lz4js` (a CJS-only dep with no exports field) through a bundler that handles CJS↔ESM interop (Vite/Webpack/Rollup with `esModuleInterop`). `tsc` only transpiles TypeScript; it does not bundle deps into dist/. If you publish this package without a bundling step, consumers in pure-Node-ESM environments may see `lz4 is undefined` — switch to `lz4-wasm` or pre-bundle if that matters.
